reviewed_modules.rationale: Package layout, signing, provenance, and smoke verification share one release contract.
Download, archive validation, provenance, and atomic publication form one fail-closed transaction.

The page owns top-level stage orchestration; separable panels remain lazy components. Reviewed when the review-surface work pushed it past its point: three things there were not stage orchestration and moved out — root and folder editing to useRootFolders, the saved-recipe library to useRecipes, and the operation-center view-model transform to lib/operationCenter, together 160 lines. What remains is stage state, the two validation gates, the run lifecycle, and the composition of screens and dialogs; those share one answer to 'which stage is the user on and may they leave it', so the point moves rather than the module splitting again.
Review preflight, execution, and reconciliation share one snapshot contract.

The service coordinates one verified sorting transaction; transfer, duplicate, conversion, repair, and persistence implementations already live behind injected services. Splitting the transaction coordinator would duplicate rollback and outcome state. Reviewed again when a distinct plan-authorization failure path was added: that path belongs to the same transaction's outcome handling, not to a new responsibility, so the point moves rather than the module splitting.
